_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base-rate dominates: no named breaker, so remain Disbelief until confirmed otherwise.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial split — analyst firm HOLD/Disbelief; narrative silent on phase but inflow tone is mildly bearish
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds ~50-62 and 30d momentum stays below ~70 with funding near flat
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G >62 with momentum >~75 and funding heating (Hope), or F&G <47 on VIX spike/long unwind (Anxiety)
